subject: Post-call recap: CentraBank private VPC / air-gapped requirements
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: David Lopez <d.lopez@centrabank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap: CentraBank private VPC / air-gapped requirements

Hi David / Alice / IT Security team,

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick write-up of what we heard and next steps so we all have the same picture.

Summary of pain points and goals
- Primary driver: regulatory requirement to keep all model inference and logs within CentraBank's VPC and on-prem locations (data residency + auditability).
- Air-gap interest: prefer an install where control plane communications are optional/paused and all requests route only inside the bank network for sensitive workloads.
- Networking: no outbound internet egress from the inference nodes; strict firewall rules and limited NAT access.
- Key management: customer-managed KMS/HSM for encryption keys and hardware-backed key lifecycle.
- Observability: need audit logs and per-request tracing sent to an internal SIEM; long-term retention policies (7+ years) may apply for certain logs.

What Redwood can offer (high level)
- Private deployment (VPC or on-prem) with a customer-managed control plane option.
- Support for customer KMS/HSM integration and audit-log exporting.
- Air-gap installation patterns: packages that allow zero-outbound configuration and offline upgrades.
- Network checklist and sample architecture for edge routing and subnet placement (attached).

Open questions we flagged
1) Which team will own the firewall/NAT changes and can we get a contact for them?
2) Can you confirm the expected peak qps and average sequence lengths for the inference workloads? This helps sizing GPU pools.
3) Any vendor onboarding constraints (e.g., specific SOC/ISO evidence) beyond SOC 2 Type II?

Next steps (agreed on call)
- Camila / Marissa to share: SOC 2 summary + private deployment architecture and network checklist (attached).
- CentraBank to share: network contact + expected qps telemetry + any procurement timeline (if available).
- Schedule a technical deep-dive with your infra/security team to walk the firewall requirements and key management integrations.

Proposed times for the technical deep-dive: Nov 18–20 (US/Eastern friendly). If those don't work, propose alternatives and we'll adjust.

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, centrabank-network-checklist.xlsx, rdw-private-deploy-arch.png

Thanks — looking forward to continuing the conversation.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Redwood Inference — developer-first inference platform for hosted, dedicated, and private deployments
From: David Lopez <d.lopez@centrabank.com>

Cc: Alice Martinez <alice.martinez@centrabank.com>, IT Security <itsecurity@centrabank.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 19:45:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: CentraBank private VPC / air-gapped requirements

Camila —

Thanks for the clear summary. Confirming a few points from our side and answering the open questions:

- Network contact: forwarding to our lead network engineer, Alice Martinez (alice.martinez@centrabank.com) — Alice, can you pick a time for the deep-dive?
- Firewall/NAT: Current policy blocks general outbound traffic from the inference subnets. We can provision NAT for specific endpoints if negotiated, but preference is to avoid any egress where possible.
- QPS: For phase 1 we estimate peak ~200 qps for short sequences (avg 128 tokens) with bursts up to 500 qps for batch scoring. We'll share historical telemetry next week.
- Compliance evidence: SOC 2 Type II is necessary; ISO 27001 is nice-to-have. We may also request penetration test summary and encryption-at-rest details.

A couple of clarification items:
- For the air-gapped pattern, do you support offline model updates (we'd need a secure, auditable package upload flow)?
- Will audit logs be exportable to our SIEM via a push or pull mechanism? We need push with TLS mutual auth.

Appreciate the attachments — will review and follow up.

Thanks,
David
Director, AI Platform & Automation | CentraBank
D: +1 (212) 555-0899

David / Alice / team —

Thanks for the quick reply and for confirming the qps profile and network posture. Quick answers to your clarifications:

- Offline model updates: yes. We support an audited package upload workflow for air-gapped installs. Packages are signed, and we provide step-by-step verification checksums for your security team. We'll include the upload flow doc in the next package.
- Audit logs export: we support push-based log export with mTLS and can send to your SIEM. We will work with your security team on cert exchange and endpoints.

Next immediate steps:
1) Marissa will send the full SOC 2 Type II report and penetration test summary under NDA.
2) I'll coordinate with Alice to schedule a 60–90 minute technical deep-dive (network + KMS + deployment ops). Suggested window: Nov 18 at 11:00 AM Eastern — does that work for your team?
3) Please share the telemetry CSV (peak/avg qps + sequence length distribution) when convenient. That will let us size an initial Dedicated pool for your proof-of-concept.

I've attached an updated network checklist and the private-deploy reference architecture PNG.

If helpful, Vivek can join the deep-dive to answer sizing and fallback routing questions.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
